text: ZEturf is the online horse-race betting brand of the FDJ United group, which completed its acquisition of ZEturf at the end of September 2023. As at 30 June 2025 the French State held 21.1% of FDJ United, and the appointment of its chairman and chief executive is subject to approval by the French budget and economy ministers.
short: ZEturf is FDJ United's horse-betting brand; the French State holds 21.1% of FDJ United.
